scripts.setup: npm --prefix ui install && npm --prefix app install
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:ui
scripts.app: npm run build:ui && npm --prefix app start
scripts.build:engine:universal: cmake -S engine -B engine/build-universal -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release "-DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES=arm64;x86_64" && cmake --build engine/build-universal -j 10 --target VenueTunerEngine
scripts.package: npm run build:engine:universal && npm run build:ui && npm run manual && npm --prefix app run dist
